input: One sanitized V2000 or V3000 MOL block; preserve atom order and explicit/implicit hydrogens, add no atoms.
coordinates: Exactly 3N finite float64 values in atom order, in angstrom.

gasteiger.hydrogens: Preserve input representation; implicit hydrogen charge remains on RDKit's separate implicit-H reservoir.

gradient: Analytic dE/dx in kcal/(mol angstrom); forces are its negative.

nonbondedPolicy.constructionCoordinates: MOL conformer at context creation; term membership remains fixed for that job.

lifecycle: One molecule and force field per context; repeated evaluations reuse both. Caller deletes the embind context in finally or terminates its owning worker on cancellation.
failure: Reject incomplete UFF atom typing, invalid coordinates, non-finite energy/gradient, or bounds violations. No force-field substitution. Binding reports bounded error strings; JS adapter throws Error.
